MessageAddUser

public static int MessageAddUser(java.lang.String stringId,
                                 int output,
                                 int expire,
                                 int repeat,
                                 int frequency)
Adds a game message with the text passed as a string table entry by the user
Parameters:
stringId - the string table id of the string to output
output - the output "channel" for the message (a GAMEMESSAGE_OUTPUT_ constant)
expire - the expiration time of the message in ms (0 for infinite)
repeat - how many times to repeat the message (0 for infinite)
frequency - the frequency of the message in ms
Returns:
a message guid, or 0 for failure

MessageAddSystem

public static int MessageAddSystem(int systemId,
                                   int output,
                                   int expire,
                                   int repeat,
                                   int frequency)
Adds a game message with the text coming from the string table, with id = GAMEMESSAGE_SYSTEMn where n is the systemId passed
Parameters:
systemId - the value to concatenate to "GAMEMESSAGE_SYSTEM" to get the string table id.
output - the output "channel" for the message (a GAMEMESSAGE_OUTPUT_ constant)
expire - the expiration time of the message in ms (0 for infinite)
repeat - how many times to repeat the message (0 for infinite)
frequency - the frequency of the message in ms
Returns:
a message guid, or 0 for failure

AddBuySell

public boolean AddBuySell(java.lang.String filename,
                          int thingGuid,
                          java.lang.String descriptionId,
                          int flags,
                          float buyRate,
                          float sellRate,
                          int sellFlags)
Adds a buy/sell (shop). This creates the shop and gives it its initial inventory.
Parameters:
filename - the store filename
thingGuid - the guid of the "shop keeper" (or any unique store identifier, the shopkeeper's guid is just a very good choice :-))
descriptionId - the stringID of the shop name in the localised string table
flags - buy/sell flags
buyRate - how the shop prices are modified when you buy
sellRate - how the shop prices are modified when you sell
sellFlags - what you can sell to the shop (what types of items it accepts to buy)
Returns:
success or failure
